summary: Task 05 is implemented exactly as specified: one pure, side-effect-free exported function over two plain strings, no imports at all, and a unit test file that covers all five TDD Anchor cases. Both verification gates pass locally (npx vitest run tests/unit/groupTitle.test.ts — 5/5 green on Node v22.23.1; npx tsc --noEmit — clean, exit 0). Naming, file placement and test style match the existing project conventions (boardLayoutUtils.ts, statusTransitions.test.ts), and the exported name matches the one Task 06 will call.

suggestions.suggestion: Optional: add one assertion pinning the degenerate contract expect(resolveGroupTitle('', '')).toBe(''). The task's Edge cases section names this case explicitly and rules out a dedicated branch for it; a single assertion would document that 'no special handling' is deliberate rather than an oversight, without adding any code to the module.
suggestions.benefit: Makes the intentionally unhandled edge case visible to the next reader and locks the behaviour if the implementation is ever rewritten.

suggestions.suggestion: Informational only, no change recommended: the header comment is in Russian, which conflicts with the global rule 'code and technical docs in English' but matches every comparable module already in this repo (src/ui/boardLayoutUtils.ts, src/logic/statusTransitions.ts, src/data/types.ts, src/utils/dateFormat.ts). CLAUDE.md's 'match existing style / do not improve adjacent code' rule wins here — keep the comment as is; switching only this file would make the codebase inconsistent.
suggestions.benefit: Records the known convention conflict so it is not re-raised as a defect in later reviews of this feature.

dimensionNotes.architecture: Pure helper in src/ui/ alongside boardLayoutUtils.ts — correct layer, zero dependencies, no state, no side effects. Single responsibility: resolves, does not normalize (Decision 7 boundary respected).
dimensionNotes.separationOfConcerns: One export, one line of logic. Trim is used only as an emptiness probe; the stored value is returned verbatim, so normalization stays in the store/loader as mandated.
dimensionNotes.readability: Function name and parameter names read as the domain rule. The single header comment explains the non-obvious choice (plain strings instead of Group) rather than restating the code.
dimensionNotes.errorHandling: Not applicable — total function over two strings, no throwing paths, no async. Absence of runtime null/undefined guards is mandated by the task (strict TS plus load-time normalization).
dimensionNotes.typeSafety: Both parameters and the return value explicitly typed as string. No any, no assertions, no non-null operators. tsc --noEmit clean.
dimensionNotes.testing: All five TDD Anchor cases present as separate it blocks: empty, whitespace-only (space, tab, newline and a mixed run), non-empty wins, surrounding whitespace preserved verbatim, default label returned unmodified including a non-ASCII/padded label. Style matches tests/unit/statusTransitions.test.ts; file is collected by the include glob tests/unit/**/*.test.ts.
dimensionNotes.dependencies: No new packages. Zero imports in the module — the ban on svelte, src/i18n, src/stores and src/data/types is satisfied literally.
dimensionNotes.security: No user input handling, no DOM, no HTML rendering, no persistence, no secrets. The returned string is later interpolated by Svelte, which auto-escapes; nothing here weakens that.
dimensionNotes.performance: O(n) trim on a value capped at 40 characters, called per render of at most six group headers. Memoization is correctly omitted (also explicitly forbidden by the task).
dimensionNotes.crossFileConsistency: No consumers exist yet — Task 06 wires them. The export name resolveGroupTitle matches the name recorded in the task Details, and the module path src/ui/groupTitle.ts matches the path Tasks 06 and 08 reference. Test import path ../../src/ui/groupTitle resolves. Second argument will be fed from groupLabels in src/i18n/index.ts, a derived store of Record<GroupId, string> — type-compatible with the string parameter.
